scientific_role: Membangun skenario PLTMH–ELC, melakukan simulasi kandidat gain, menetapkan target Kp/Ki berbasis objective yang dibekukan, dan menghasilkan trajectory temporal mentah.
input_contract: Validated PLTMH–ELC source model; scenario design; fixed RK4 numerical policy.
output_contract: Scenario catalogue + gain labels + raw temporal trajectories BEFORE supervised window construction.
boundary_end: Raw labeled trajectories are available; NO causal ML windows, train/val/test family split, or scaler fitting yet.

scientific_role: Mengubah trajectory mentah menjadi dataset supervised yang kausal dan leakage-safe.
output_contract: Final feature set, causal windows, family-level train/validation/test split, train-only scalers, final NPZ dataset, sample metadata.
boundary_end: FINAL_LSTM_QLSTM_READY dataset and scalers are frozen.

scientific_role: Classical baselines, LSTM training, temporal audit, endpoint MLP, multi-seed validation stability.
input_contract: Frozen final dataset, train-only scaler, frozen family split.
output_contract: Frozen classical LSTM + baseline models and validation/test audits.
boundary_end: Classical model-stage evidence frozen before QLSTM training.

scientific_role: QLSTM runtime feasibility, architecture freeze, training, validation, single frozen test evaluation, model-stage interpretation.
input_contract: Same frozen dataset/split/scalers used by classical LSTM.
output_contract: Frozen QLSTM checkpoint, QLSTM evaluation, model comparison and interpretation freeze.
boundary_end: Model development closed; no post-test tuning.

scientific_role: Mengintegrasikan Fixed PI, frozen LSTM, dan frozen QLSTM ke PLTMH–ELC serta menjalankan 12 eksperimen closed-loop yang dipraregistrasikan.
input_contract: Frozen LSTM + frozen QLSTM + frozen scheduler policy + frozen physical scenarios.
output_contract: Closed-loop trajectories, gain-update records, controller metrics and raw comparative results.
boundary_start: Scheduler interface and gain-safety policy freeze.
boundary_end: Raw 12-run comparative closed-loop results checkpointed before interpretation.

scientific_role: Audit hasil model dan closed-loop, scientific claim freeze, computational audit, figures/tables, dan penyusunan Bab IV.
output_contract: Scientific interpretation, tables, figures, claim limits and Bab IV draft.
boundary_end: Thesis-ready scientific evidence package and Bab IV.
